items.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
items.content: OpenAI shares a framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI shares a framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior.

summaries.zh: OpenAI发布了一个用于追踪、调查和披露模型行为偏差的框架，并附有六份关于模型意外或令人担忧行为的报告。该框架旨在系统化管理模型与预期不符的情况，确保透明度和责任感。
summaries.en: OpenAI presents a framework for monitoring, examining, and reporting instances of model misalignment. The framework accompanies six reports detailing unexpected or concerning behaviors exhibited by AI models. The initiative aims to provide transparency and accountability in addressing discrepancies between model outputs and intended objectives.

items.title: How workers are unlocking new ways of working
items.content: New OpenAI Economic Research shows how workers use AI beyond traditional roles and which new activities become recurring parts of their work.
items.contentSnippet: New OpenAI Economic Research shows how workers use AI beyond traditional roles and which new activities become recurring parts of their work.

summaries.zh: 新开放AI经济研究显示，工人在工作中使用AI已超越传统角色，并将AI相关任务转化为工作的一部分。
summaries.en: OpenAI's research reveals that workers are leveraging AI beyond conventional tasks, integrating it into their daily routines. The study highlights emerging activities that have become routine as workers adopt AI tools, expanding the scope of AI-driven work processes.

items.title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
items.content: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.
